meta.name: seo-content-service-page
meta.description: Build service pages and landing pages that rank and convert for agencies, consultants, trades, clinics, law firms, and SaaS. Input: a service, business, and target area. Output: a field-tested wireframe (hero + CTA, social proof, benefits, numbered process, founder bio, 750+ word SEO block, reviews, FAQ), title/H1/slug/meta patterns, a competitor depth benchmark, region/city pages, and a GEO layer. Use for a service page, landing page, lead-generation page, or city/service-area page that gets no organic leads.
